fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

let found: int? =
    for n in 1::100000 do
        if n * n - (n - 1) * (n - 1) > 1000 then break n fi
    od

if let n = found then
    let square = n * n
    let previous = (n - 1) * (n - 1)

    write_line("{n}: {square} - {previous} = {square - previous}")
fi
